opening.argument: Bitcoin and Ethereum price analysis is the substance of this presentation. The speaker directs viewers to TradingView for entry levels, targets and market trends, gives conditional Bitcoin entry levels around 75,000 and 74,000, and shows charts with indicators and price levels. The premium Telegram channel is promoted alongside that trading commentary, and the description expressly says the videos are not financial advice. The available evidence does not establish fees, private-data requests, destination behavior, authenticity or achieved returns. On this record, the channel promotion does not establish a deceptive mechanism.
